Container.Name: abs-audiobookdb
Container.Overview: Read-only AudiobookDB metadata provider for Audiobookshelf. Set a real operator contact here and your AudiobookDB API key in ABS. Supports direct LAN or shared Docker networking; no reverse proxy or persistent storage required. Initial development release. The container has no web interface or shell.

Config.Name: Adapter port
Config.Description: Choose a free LAN port. ABS connects to http://your-unraid-address:port; no /search suffix.

Config.Name: Operator contact
Config.Description: Required: your real email or public HTTPS contact URL, sent in the upstream User-Agent. This is not an API key.

Config.Name: Go memory target
Config.Description: Go soft memory target; keep below the 256 MiB container limit.
